transformer.name: avro-x-java-object
transformer.title: Avro X Java Object
transformer.description: Transforms from JSon to Java object using Jackson Avro (supports content schema)

transformerIn.description: Json text, or Avro binary with the Avro schema in the X-Content-Schema exchange property, read into the class of the X-Content-Class exchange property, which a body other than a POJO needs: a POJO of that class, or any POJO without it, is kept, and a Map or a null body fail

transformerOut.description: An object of the class of the X-Content-Class exchange property
